Everything below comes from the files in `src/main/java`; I ignored tests. Four production classes are directly related to `Visit`:

- **`BaseEntity`** is the only class `Visit` uses: it inherits from it.
- **`Pet`** holds a set of visits.
- **`Owner`** adds a visit to one of its pets.
- **`VisitController`** creates and validates visits.

The diagram also shows `Owner` → `Pet`, `VisitController` → `Owner` and `Pet`, and `Owner`/`Pet` → `Person`/`NamedEntity` for context. Those links don't involve `Visit` itself.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class BaseEntity {
        <<MappedSuperclass>>
        -Integer id
        +getId() Integer
        +setId(Integer id) void
        +isNew() boolean
    }

    class Visit {
        <<Entity>>
        -LocalDate date
        -String description
        +Visit()
        +getDate() LocalDate
        +setDate(LocalDate date) void
        +getDescription() String
        +setDescription(String description) void
    }

    class Pet {
        <<Entity>>
        -LocalDate birthDate
        -PetType type
        -Set~Visit~ visits
        +getVisits() Collection~Visit~
        +addVisit(Visit visit) void
    }

    class Owner {
        <<Entity>>
        -String address
        -String city
        -String telephone
        -List~Pet~ pets
        +getPet(Integer id) Pet
        +addVisit(Integer petId, Visit visit) void
    }

    class VisitController {
        <<Controller>>
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +loadPetWithVisit(int ownerId, int petId, Map model) Visit
        +minVisitDate() LocalDate
        +initNewVisitForm() String
        +processNewVisitForm(Owner owner, int petId, Visit visit, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes) String
    }

    BaseEntity <|-- Visit : extends
    Pet "1" o-- "*" Visit : visits
    Owner ..> Visit : addVisit(petId, visit)
    Owner "1" o-- "*" Pet : pets
    VisitController ..> Visit : creates / validates
    VisitController ..> Pet : addVisit
    VisitController ..> Owner : addVisit / save
    NamedEntity <|-- Pet : extends
    Person <|-- Owner : extends
```
